caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, intricately detailed shell, positioned with its opening facing right and slightly downwards. The shell’s exterior displays a series of segmented, rib-like structures that are shaded with tones of beige, light brown, and gray, providing a textured appearance. The inner surface shows a smoother, somewhat glossy texture with lighter cream and tan hues, and subtle circular patterns creating a sense of depth. The rim and several spiral edges of the shell are adorned with a fringe of small, dark, irregular shapes, appearing almost fuzzy or moss-like, rendered in dark gray to black colors. The overall composition centers the shell against a plain, off-white background, and there are no additional objects or elements present in the image. The artist’s name, “Pietro Candini,” is written in small, neat text at the lower right section of the drawing.
title: Silk Bonnet
